data.body: **[P2] Account for opaque objects' retained referents.** This fallback only inspects `__dict__` and slots, so a small wrapper such as `memoryview(bytearray(...))` is counted as tiny even though it keeps the entire backing buffer alive. A blocked lane can consequently retain far more than the advertised 16 MB and exhaust Lambda memory. Traverse relevant referents—at least `memoryview.obj`—or conservatively reject opaque values whose retained graph cannot be bounded, and add a custom-renderable memoryview regression.
